value.rationale: Precludes stationary heterogeneous patterns and alternative recurrent states for an entire biologically motivated mixed activation–inhibition family with arbitrary unequal diffusion on domains of any spatial dimension. The explicit global convergence rate depends only on computable endpoint evaluations; it is not a finite toy calculation or a textbook local linear stability test. It draws a structural boundary at unit Hill gain, Neumann geometry and diagonal diffusion.
